note: Conceptual/architecture lesson on where integration secrets should live (Protected Custom Metadata's managed-package-only protection, Named Credentials, encrypted custom fields, external vaults) and rotation discipline, taught through narrative and a storage-decision Lab rather than screenshots, per this course's conceptual/architecture policy.
